body.name: CompletionComplexityDichotomyHandle
body.construction: Resolve the exact complexity of \(\operatorname{CompOpt}(\widetilde W,\mathcal G,\ell;g,r,c)\) by pursuing two auditable branches. For a polynomial branch, eliminate the ordered groups with fraction-free updates while carrying a polynomial-size rank signature, or derive a polynomial separation oracle for the feasible signature set. For a hardness branch, encode coupled downstream zero cancellations by exact rational gadgets and then isolate a nontrivial tractable restriction through dynamic programming on the induced group-interaction graph.
